source_documents.title: Photophysical Properties of an Azine-Linked Pyrene− Cinnamaldehyde Hybrid: Evidence of Solvent-Dependent Charge-Transfer-Coupled Excimer Emission

reference_evidence_units.quote: the addition of water diminished the CT band, and the high-energy band experienced increment in intensity.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PYNC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Methanol/water and acetonitrile/water mixtures with increasing water fraction.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Increasing water changes the two emission bands in opposite directions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Solvent polarity and aggregation change together; the titration alone does not distinguish them.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the increasing concentration of probe in solvents other than water contributes to increment of the high-energy emission band
reference_evidence_units.subject: PYNC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Concentration series in methanol, water and acetonitrile.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The high-energy emission grows with concentration outside water.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The statement concerns concentration dependence, not a directly measured excited dimer structure.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the high-energy band diminishes gradually with an increment of a band at ∼590 nm.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PYNC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Increasing PEG400 fraction in water, used as a viscosity perturbation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The two bands respond oppositely as PEG400 is added.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: PEG400 changes dielectric properties as well as viscosity.

reference_evidence_units.quote: increment of viscosity freezes the single-bond rotational motions in PYNC
reference_evidence_units.subject: PYNC
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors invoke restricted rotation to explain enhancement of the CT emission component.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a source interpretation of a mixed solvent perturbation, not a measured torsional trajectory.

reference_evidence_units.quote: PYNC was found to be totally nonfluorescent in the solid state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PYNC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solid-state emission compared with emission in water.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Solid PYNC is nonfluorescent under the reported comparison.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This limits a generic AIE assignment but does not rule out every aggregate-related excited state.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the high-energy band was due to the pyrene excimer and the polarity-sensitive band was due to excited-state intramolecular charge transfer in PYNC.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PYNC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Reported solvent, concentration, viscosity and solid-state comparisons.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source assigns separate bands to excimer emission and intramolecular CT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: These are the paper's assignments, not an independent confirmation by this pipeline.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a biexponential nature of decay was observed in all solvents except water, where monoexponential decay having a considerably long lifetime was obtained
reference_evidence_units.subject: PYNC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 375 nm excitation, detection at the assigned excimer band.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The decay at the assigned excimer band depends on solvent.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The source discusses solvent complexes; lifetime components should not be treated as uniquely identified species.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Upon deconvoluting the decay profiles, lifetime components were obtained that fall below the instrumental response function.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PYNC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: CT-band fluorescence decay following 375 nm excitation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source reports fitted CT lifetime components below the instrumental response function.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not present these components as independently resolved CT formation or transfer times. The source instead discusses average lifetimes.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Motion restriction is an enabling explanation of viscosity-enhanced CT emission, not a general claim that PYNC is AIE-active.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The separate polarity-sensitive CT emission is the other central source interpretation.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The excimer interpretation is central to the paper and supported by several target-specific perturbations.
